page.layout: Two parallel columns of running text on one printed page: left column (continuation of a bibliographic list, from top to bottom), then right column headed "LIBRI DE ANIMA" with its sub-list of letters A, I, M, N, P, S. No page number, no running head, no catchword visible.

main_text.p: libros de Anima.
Simo Brosserius edidit epitome physices.
Simo de Euerfam scripsit quæstiones de Anima lib. 1. de sensu & sensato lib. 1. Quæstiones in Meteor. lib. 4.
Simon Gryneus Arist. librü de Mundo ad Alexandrum commentariis illustrauit.
Simon Simonius edidit Disputationem de Anima, & commentarin Arist. lib. de Sensu & sensili, & de Memoria.
Simplicius commentatus est in 8. libros Physic. 4. de Cœlo, 2. de Anima.
Sophronius scripsit paraphrasin Græcam in Arist. libros de Anima, de Memoria & sequentes.
Stephanus Cyrius commentatus est in Arist. lib. de Anima.
main_text.head: T
main_text.p: Theodorus Metochita scripsit Physicam Græcam, siue commentarios in Arist libros de Auscultatione vsque ad librum de Memoria.
Themisti⁹ edidit paraphrasin in octo lib. Physic. de Anima, Memoria, & reminiscentia, de somno & vigilia, de insomniis, de diuinatione per somnum.
Theobaldus Gerlachius scripsit Annotationes in Arist. libros Physic. & Meteorologicos.
Theophilus Zimara Marci Antonij F. commentarios edidit in 3. libros Arist. de Anima.
Thomas de Aquino commentatus est in 8. libros Physic. de Cœlo, de Generat. & Corrupt. de Anima, in tota fere parua Naturalia.
Thomas de Vio Caietanus coment. edidit in Arist. libros de Anima.
Thomas Valden scripsit in Physica Aristotelis, libros 4. de Cœlo 4. Generat. & Corruptione. 1. Meteorum 4. de Anima, 3.
main_text.head: V
main_text.p: Vincentij Quintiani Dilucidationes trium librorum Arist. de Anima extant.
main_text.head: LIBRI DE ANIMALIBUS, hoc est. De historia lib. 10. De partibus lib. 4. De generatione lib. 5. De motu lib. 1. De gressu lib. 1.
A
main_text.p: Asinius Pollio Trallianus, scripsit epitomen ad Aristotelem de Animalibus lib. 10.
Augustinus Niphus Philotheus Suessanus Arist. libros de Hist. animal. partibus, earumq. caussis ex Th. Gazæ translatione ad Græca exemplaria recognouit, & scholijs illustrauit.
Auerrois Paraph. in libros 9. de Generat. animal. eiusdem media expositio in libros 9. de hist. anim.
main_text.head: I
main_text.p: Ioannes Gramaticus scripsit in libros Arist. de Generatione animalium.
Ioannes Kenyngale scripsit in Arist. de Animalibus lib. 1.
Iulius Cæsar Scaliger librum decimū De historia animalium transtulit, & doctissimis commentarijs illustrauit. Eiusdem in reliquos eius operis libros commentarij auidissimè à doctis viris expectantur.
main_text.head: M
main_text.p: Michael Ephesius commentatus est in libros Arist. De partibus animalium.
main_text.head: N
main_text.p: Nicolaus Leonicenus primum librū Arist. lib. De partibus animalium transtulit & explanauit.
Nicolaus Leonicenus paraphrasin edidit in Arist. lib. De motu animal.
main_text.head: P
main_text.p: Petrus Alcyonius Arist. lib. De motu & gressu animalium transtulit.
Petrus Alcyonius libros 10. Aristotelis De animalibus transtulit.
Petrus de Aluernia commentatus est in Arist. lib. De motu animalium.
Paulus Belmisserus libros duos priores De animal. 36. elegiis expressit.
main_text.head: S
main_text.p: Simon de Euersham scripsit in Arist.

page.notes: Left column is partly damaged at the top edge and some words are uncertain; right column's last line is cut off by the page edge. Marked readings are best-effort, e.g. "Themisti⁹" and "Valden" may be misprints; "Vincentij" and "Euersham" have doubtful letters. The heading on the right is set in italic and is treated as a level-1 division title.
